channel.description: বাংলাদেশ, ভারত ও বিশ্বের সর্বশেষ খবর — স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে আপডেটেড

item.title: Trump waives certain Russia sanctions under new legislation
item.description: President Trump has bypassed provisions of a new law designed to penalize Moscow for the war in Ukraine. He stated that enforcing these specific measures would run counter to American national interests.

item.title: ১৮ অক্টোবর ২০২৬-এর খেলা সম্প্রচারের তালিকা
item.description: ১৮ অক্টোবর টেলিভিশন ও অনলাইনে ঘরোয়া ও আন্তর্জাতিক বিভিন্ন খেলা সরাসরি দেখানো হবে। তালিকায় রয়েছে জাতীয় ক্রিকেট লিগের চারটি খেলা, যার মধ্যে সিলেট ও রংপুরের ম্যাচটি সকাল সাড়ে নয়টায় বিসিবি ইউটিউবে প্রচারিত হবে। এছাড়া পাকিস্তানের ত্রিদেশীয় সিরিজ, গেবেখা টেস্ট, ইংলিশ প্রিমিয়ার লিগ ও লা লিগার ম্যাচ সম্প্রচারিত হবে।

item.title: কে-পপ ব্যান্ড 'বিগ ওশান'-এর গান ও পরিবেশনা
item.description: দক্ষিণ কোরিয়ার সঙ্গীত দল 'বিগ ওশান'-এর তিনজন সদস্যই শ্রবণপ্রতিবন্ধী। তারা সুর, নৃত্য এবং ইশারা ভাষার মেলবন্ধনে মঞ্চে গান পরিবেশন করে দর্শকের মনোযোগ আকর্ষণ করছেন। এই কে-পপ ব্যান্ডটি তাদের ভিন্নধর্মী পরিবেশনার মাধ্যমে কনসার্টে ব্যাপক জনপ্রিয়তা অর্জন করেছে।

item.title: আত্মোপলব্ধি ও কর্মজীবন নিয়ে এক আলাপের দৃশ্য
item.description: চা পানের সময় রাফি নামের এক ব্যক্তি জীবন ও আত্মানুসন্ধান নিয়ে গভীর কথা বলেন। তাঁর বক্তব্য শুনে আখ্যানকারের মনে ধারণা জন্মায় যে রাফি হয়তো নিজের কর্মক্ষেত্র ত্যাগ করার চিন্তা করছেন। কথোপকথনটি মানুষের বাহ্যিক চেনা-জানা ও অন্তর্জগতের মধ্যকার তফাত কেন্দ্র করে গড়ে উঠেছে।

item.title: মনোবিজ্ঞানে প্যারাসোশ্যাল সম্পর্কের ধারণা
item.description: কোনো ব্যক্তির সাথে সরাসরি চেনা-জানা না থাকা সত্ত্বেও তাঁর প্রতি মানসিক টান অনুভব করাকে মনস্তত্ত্বের ভাষায় 'প্যারাসোশ্যাল রিলেশনশিপ' বলা হয়। সাধারণত তারকাদের জীবন নিয়ে সাধারণ মানুষের আগ্রহের পেছনে এই মনস্তাত্ত্বিক বিষয়টি কাজ করে। এর মাধ্যমে না দেখা কোনো বিখ্যাত ব্যক্তির সাথে একপক্ষীয় মানসিক যোগাযোগ তৈরি হয়।

item.title: বন্যপ্রাণী আলোকচিত্র পুরস্কার বিজয়ী আন্তর্জাতিক ও বাংলাদেশি ছবি
item.description: আন্তর্জাতিক বন্যপ্রাণী আলোকচিত্র প্রতিযোগিতায় বিজয়ী আলোকচিত্রীদের মধ্যে একজন বাংলাদেশি স্থান পেয়েছেন। পুরস্কারপ্রাপ্ত একটি ছবিতে এক হাতিকে তার মৃত ছানাকে শুঁড় ও দাঁত দিয়ে ধরে রাখার বিরল দৃশ্য দেখা যায়। প্রাকৃতিক পরিবেশের এসব দুর্লভ মুহূর্ত বন্দি করার স্বীকৃতিস্বরূপ এই সম্মাননা প্রদান করা হয়।

item.title: Saudi-Led Coalition Launches Airstrikes Near Taiz
item.description: Aerial bombardments were carried out near the Yemeni municipality of Taiz by military forces under Saudi leadership. Coalition officials declared that the operation aimed to dismantle the blockade enforced by Houthi rebels around the city.

item.title: European Officials and Palestinians Assaulted in West Bank
item.description: Disguised Israeli inhabitants targeted foreign representatives from Europe, a municipality leader from France, and local residents in the occupied West Bank. The violent incident involved direct aggression against the diplomatic group and community members.

item.title: INS Samarthak, first indigenous multi-purpose vessel, commissioned
item.description: As reported by The Hindu, Radhakrishnan presided over the commissioning in Karwar of the first of two multi. Key points: Samarthak, Vice, President, Radhakrishnan.

item.title: Bescom Sets October 31 Deadline for Vacant Home Gruha Jyothi Documents
item.description: Bescom directed proprietors of empty or locked properties to provide required paperwork for the Gruha Jyothi scheme by October 31. The utility company issued the notice to facilitate the ongoing survey process.

item.title: US Lifts Sanction Warnings on Russian Crude Imports
item.description: Threat of economic penalties regarding Russian petroleum acquisitions has been set aside by Donald Trump ahead of upcoming US legislative contests. This decision provides financial breathing room to petroleum processing companies in India during the active turmoil in the Middle East.

item.title: Field difficulties complicate India Census operations
item.description: Data collectors for the upcoming Census report facing operational hazards on the ground, such as extreme heat, poor network access, and security risks. Despite a digital setup for live tracking, staff cite difficult working conditions.

item.title: Meerut Court Sentences Wife And Lover To Death For Murder
item.description: A woman and her partner received death sentences for murdering her husband and placing a snake on his bed to disguise the crime. Investigators noted that an autopsy revealed neck and nose injuries, confirming death by strangulation.

item.title: Supreme Court to hear petition involving Rahul Gandhi
item.description: The top court has agreed to schedule a petition claiming a pregnant reporter was mishandled during an October march. A senior lawyer mentioned the matter before the Chief Justice, noting the incident occurred at court grounds.

item.title: Actor Imran Khan challenges departure notice in Bombay HC
item.description: The U.S. citizen has filed a writ petition in court claiming an expulsion directive violates constitutional rights and stems from a biased complaint. A new directive requires him to justify why his OCI status should remain active.

item.title: Maritime body restricts Indian crew assignments in Sarawak
item.description: The Directorate General of Maritime Administration has prohibited placing Indian sailors in the Malaysian area. This action comes after multiple fatal incidents involving young Indian mariners in the area over time.

item.title: Minister clarifies local funding rules for transport depots
item.description: Transport Minister C.P. John stated that local bodies are not mandated to finance KSRTC facilities. He responded to concerns by noting that financially stable municipal councils may choose to support depot upgrades voluntarily.

item.title: Activists freed after Delhi demonstrations and peace bonds
item.description: Student leader Neha Bora was liberated from custody following protests, while another activist executed a peace agreement. Women's organizations continue local demonstrations demanding accountability from city law enforcement.

item.title: Supreme Court plea challenges peace breach detentions
item.description: Scholar Apoorvanand Jha filed a petition arguing that labeling peaceful protest calls as law-and-order breaches strips citizens of their demonstration rights. The legal filing describes these allegations as a tactic for arrests.

item.title: London sees rival rallies over Indian election officials
item.description: Indian student organizations staged a demonstration featuring activist Dhruv Rathee, while government supporters conducted a counter-rally nearby. Metropolitan Police officers maintained separation between the two opposing groups.

item.title: Presidency University sets up inquiry panel after poster vandalism
item.description: Following ABVP's allegations that leftist groups ruined a Swami Vivekananda poster at Presidency University, administration established a five-member committee. This panel must deliver its report in 15 working days.

item.title: Expert panel reveals low SC/ST share in KIIFB funding
item.description: An expert committee reported that initiatives exclusively dedicated to SC/ST advancement accounted for just 0.18 percent of the total approved outlay by KIIFB. Furthermore, only 0.21 percent of disbursed funds went toward these specific programs.

item.title: Teynampet: Fake police officer apprehended for gold theft
item.description: Authorities in Teynampet took a suspect into custody who allegedly impersonated a law enforcement officer to steal gold ornaments.

item.title: Strong 6.9 magnitude earthquake strikes off Russian coast
item.description: A seismic event initially measured at 6.5 was later upgraded to 6.9 by scientists near Ozernovskiy, Russia. The Geological Survey reported that the tremor registered as a magnitude-5 intensity in the area.

item.title: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Vijay opens Periyar Arivulagam
item.description: Chief Minister Vijay inaugurated the Periyar Arivulagam in Coimbatore, constructed at a cost of 301.71 crore rupees. During the event, he additionally unveiled a statue honoring Thanthai Periyar at the site.

item.title: Telecom providers to display caller KYC names starting November 1
item.description: Beginning November 1, telecommunications companies will present incoming callers' KYC-verified names on screens. This Caller Name Presentation initiative follows years of development and internal network trials conducted throughout 2025.

item.title: ABVP and BCJD report triumphs in Odisha campus polls
item.description: The ABVP announced dominant performances and a clean sweep in Ganjam, Kendujhar, and Mayurbhanj districts during student union elections in Odisha. Simultaneously, the BCJD stated its members secured presidential positions at four prominent universities.

item.title: Odisha plans nearly three lakh additional homes for low-income families
item.description: The Odisha government announced plans to deliver 2.91 lakh extra houses for disadvantaged residents. Funding will be drawn from a dedicated 3,500 crore rupee reserve previously designated for repair initiatives.

item.title: Black Sea drone attacks heighten concerns over NATO confrontation
item.description: Recent drone strikes in Black Sea exclusive economic zones resulted in two deaths, at least 25 missing persons, and threats to international shipping lanes. These incidents have sparked worries that the Ukraine conflict could escalate and involve NATO nations.

item.title: Ukraine strikes Russian refinery after scrapping energy truce
item.description: Following President Zelenskyy's remarks expressing disappointment in Trump, Ukrainian forces struck a Russian oil facility. This action ends a short-lived ceasefire on energy targets, which Kyiv claims Moscow failed to respect.

item.title: Tragic Stampede at Kolkata Durga Puja Event Claims 17 Lives
item.description: At least 17 people died in a crush at a north Kolkata puja marquee, prompting the Prime Minister to offer ₹2 lakh in compensation. Officials blamed a false announcement for triggering the incident.

item.title: Visakhapatnam hotels offer special Navratri menus
item.description: Hospitality venues in Visakhapatnam are serving an assortment of festive dishes for Navratri. The culinary offerings feature both traditional celebration meals and options designed for individuals observing ritual fasts.

item.title: Examining the factors behind the fatal Kolkata stampede
item.description: Authorities are investigating the primary catalysts for the deadly crowd crush in Kolkata. Potential contributing elements under review include adverse weather, heavy attendance, and confusing public announcements.

item.title: Pakistan cricket squad feels weight of ICC tournament drought
item.description: The team carries added psychological strain due to their prolonged absence from ICC championship titles. Their last appearance in an event final occurred during the 2022 T20 World Cup in Australia, resulting in a defeat to England.

item.title: Ex-England bowler Chris Woakes critiques Rob Key in new book
item.description: Veteran of 217 international games Chris Woakes criticizes Rob Key over his departure from the squad in his autobiography. Woakes concluded his red-ball career in August 2025 against India, batting despite a shoulder injury.

item.title: Anti-Trump 'No Kings' protests encourage early US voting
item.description: Demonstrators behind the anti-Trump 'No Kings' movement are prompting citizens to cast ballots ahead of the November 3 midterms. Republicans currently face difficult electoral contests to maintain their majority in Congress.

item.title: Drishyam 3 surpasses Rs 500 crore globally by day 16
item.description: Starring Ajay Devgn, 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' experienced a 61.3% jump in earnings on its third Saturday. The feature brought in Rs 5 crore on day 16, pushing its total domestic net to Rs 341.10 crore and global gross past Rs 500 crore.

item.title: West Bank incident involves assault on European diplomats by settlers
item.description: Israeli forces denounced an attack by settlers against European diplomats in the West Bank, while the prime minister's office labeled the outcry a smear effort.

item.title: Settlers assault EU diplomats in West Bank as drones hit Riyadh
item.description: Masked settlers targeted European officials in the occupied West Bank, while drone strikes prompted blazes on three tankers. Simultaneously, aerial attacks were directed at Riyadh.

item.title: Nayyi Navelli Earns Rs 4 Crore on Second Day
item.description: Yami Gautam's new movie brought in Rs 4 crore on Saturday. This brought the domestic box office cumulative earnings for the comedy, horror, and mythology feature to Rs 7.25 crore over two days.

item.title: Changing Phone SIM Cards While Powered On
item.description: While swapping subscriber identity modules is infrequent, users must handle the process carefully. Although shutting down the device is not strictly mandatory, it remains the recommended approach.

item.title: Jailer 2 Crosses Rs 300 Crore Globally on Day Three
item.description: Starring Rajinikanth, Mohanlal, and Shiva Rajkumar, the movie collected Rs 47.80 crore domestically on its third day. This marked a 28.8 percent increase, pushing its total domestic net revenue to Rs 144.60 crore and global earnings past Rs 300 crore.

item.title: Truck Kills 12 Devotees Near Gwalior Temple
item.description: A fast-moving truck struck and killed twelve worshippers close to a shrine in Gwalior. The incident resulted in twelve fatalities at the location.

item.title: Ranabaali Reaches Rs 16.55 Crore in India After Two Days
item.description: The feature starring Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna earned Rs 7.30 crore on its second day. Total domestic net collections reached Rs 16.55 crore, accompanied by an audience turnout of 551,994.

item.title: Verity Loses Over 500 Screens After Third Weekend
item.description: Facing declining ticket sales, the movie Verity was dropped from more than 500 North American theatres. Its revenue dropped from an opening of USD 32 million to USD 12 million by the subsequent weekend.

item.title: Clashes erupt as large crowds demonstrate in French cities
item.description: Authorities deployed tear gas while large demonstrations turned violent across France, with officials attributing the unrest to radical leftist groups.

item.title: US Envoy Demands Prosecution for Attack on American Reporter
item.description: Appointed envoy Mike Huckabee condemned an assault on an American journalist in the occupied West Bank. He labeled the incident a despicable act of terror and demanded that Israel prosecute the perpetrators.

item.title: Sydney Teenager on Ebike Charged with Sexual Touching
item.description: A thirteen-year-old male riding an electric bicycle in Sydney was charged with multiple offenses. Police alleged he harassed females ranging from 13 to 54 years old, involving acts of sexual touching without consent.

item.title: Troubleshooting TV connection issues on the Nintendo Switch 2
item.description: The Nintendo Switch 2 is designed to output video to television sets. Users experiencing connectivity failures can follow specific steps to diagnose the problem.

item.title: Coalition forces shoot down four drones above Saudi Arabia
item.description: Military forces under Saudi leadership detected and neutralized four unmanned aerial vehicles targeting Riyadh, the Eastern Province, and the southern territory.

item.title: OpenAI chief notes software is harder than hardware for new robot
item.description: OpenAI is developing a humanoid machine to navigate human environments. Chief Executive Sam Altman stated that creating the artificial intelligence mind is far tougher than the physical chassis.

item.title: Older Samsung Galaxy tablets approach end of software updates
item.description: While Samsung offers strong update policies for recent tablets, older hardware models are not eligible and are reaching their final year of support.

item.title: Pundits Review Manchester City's Seventh Consecutive Victory
item.description: Match of the Day analysts Joe Hart and Danny Murphy evaluated Manchester City's 3-2 triumph over Ipswich. The result keeps the club's 100 percent winning streak alive in the Premier League season.

item.title: দৈনন্দিন জীবনে রাগ নিয়ন্ত্রণের গুরুত্ব ও ইসলামি দৃষ্টিকোণ
item.description: রাস্তার নানা অনাকাঙ্ক্ষিত পরিস্থিতি বা যানজটে মেজাজ হারিয়ে ফেলা খুবই স্বাভাবিক। তবে মুমিনের প্রকৃত শক্তি প্রকাশ পায় ক্রোধ সংযত করার মাধ্যমে।

item.title: Rubio Plans Jamnagar Visit as Musk Responds to Reliance
item.description: Marco Rubio includes Jamnagar in his two-day travel schedule. Meanwhile, Elon Musk recently acknowledged and praised a social media post regarding Reliance.

item.title: Healthcare Staff Announce Strikes Amid Stormont Budget Impasse
item.description: Hospital physicians in Northern Ireland declared upcoming strikes after losing patience with prolonged budget postponements by Stormont. Earlier effects of the funding delay had appeared minimal until this escalation.

item.title: Causes of Evening Wi-Fi Slowdowns and How to Fix Them
item.description: Network congestion caused by high user traffic in the evening frequently reduces internet speeds. Users can apply simple methods to bypass these common connectivity slowdowns.

item.title: Satellite Images Reveal Luxury Vessel Near Kim Jong Un Estate
item.description: Recent satellite photos display a high-end boat featuring a 50-meter pool and water slides situated close to a summer property utilized by Kim Jong Un. This luxury contrasts sharply with the living conditions of average North Korean citizens.

item.title: Dubois Defeats Wardley in Two Rounds
item.description: Daniel Dubois secured his standing as Britain's top heavyweight. He stopped Fabio Wardley in the second round to keep his WBO title.

item.title: Maintaining Smart Home Operations Offline
item.description: Many smart home devices rely on Wi-Fi connectivity to operate. This guide examines methods to maintain functionality during internet outages.
